requirements.name: NNAS Advisory Report
requirements.detail: Create NNAS application; submit education, registration history, and identity documents for verification.

requirements.name: Language proficiency (IELTS Academic / CELBAN / OET)
requirements.detail: Required if education/experience was not in English/French. CELBAN is nursing-specific.

requirements.name: CNO registration application
requirements.detail: Apply to CNO; NNAS report is released to CNO for review against Ontario requirements.

requirements.name: NCLEX-RN
requirements.detail: National licensure exam. Must be eligible via CNO before registering for the exam.

requirements.name: Evidence of practice / criminal record check
requirements.detail: Declaration and, where required, police record check.

notes: Language test must be valid at the registration decision, not merely at application — a common expiry collision when NNAS/exam timelines slip.
